- Require authentication: OFF (domain-level restriction removed for this meeting)
- Added Greenthumb AI as a pre-approved domain for this meeting

I reissued an updated calendar invite (redwood-demo_v2.ics) and regenerated the meeting link (new link below) — please re-send to Simran and the three attendees.
